source_mechanism.qualification: Static path inspection plus matching controlled runtime behavior; not a garbage-collection race and not evidence that GC collected a live Request.
steps: Request.checkBodyStreamRef stores the readable stream in js.gc.stream and clears native Locked.readable(581-591); the URL/init construction path calls it(873).

Request(existing, initObject) copies native #body.value using clone(691-696) without forwarding the relocated stream; Request(existing) uses cloneInto(640-660), which reads js.gc.stream and calls cloneWithReadableStream(1039-1049).

Body.Value.clone delegates to cloneWithReadableStream with no supplied stream(1082-1090). A Locked body enters tee; absent the original readable/onStartStreaming producer, its fallback creates a ByteStream(998-1077), matching the observed pending zero-byte reader.
